Current RTL:
module counter_06 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] div_val,
  output clk_out
);

  reg clk_out_reg;
  reg [7:0] count_reg;
  reg [7:0] max_count;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      clk_out_reg <= 0;
      count_reg <= 0;
      max_count <= 0;
    end else begin
      if (div_val != 0) begin
        if (count_reg == 0) begin
          clk_out_reg <= ~clk_out_reg;
          count_reg <= max_count;
        end else begin
          count_reg <= count_reg - 1;
        end
      end else begin
        clk_out_reg <= 0;
      end
      max_count <= div_val;
    end
  end

  assign clk_out = clk_out_reg;

endmodule
